name: A.L.A.N.
source:
For Alex, the City of Xodias is not an ordinary town. This young boy is a Rift Breaker. He has the huge responsibility to fight the monsters spawning from Rifts, mysterious cracks of light only a handful of children can see. As a Rift Breaker, Alex possesses supernatural powers that’ll help him on his mission. Now, he and his friends Lily, Aime and Nana must protect the City of Xodias from monsters by destroying every single Rift they come across.

[From Steam (removed)]
translation:
对于亚历克斯来说，索迪亚斯市并不是一个普通的城镇。这个小男孩是一名裂缝破坏者。他肩负着与裂缝中产生的怪物战斗的巨大责任，裂缝是只有少数孩子才能看到的神秘光裂缝。作为裂谷者，亚历克斯拥有超自然的力量，可以帮助他完成任务。现在，他和他的朋友莉莉、艾梅和娜娜必须摧毁他们遇到的每一个裂缝，保护索迪亚斯城免受怪物的侵害。

[来自Steam（已删除）]
